name: Twisted Carnival
source:
No one knows where the Carnival of Curiosities will appear. Every five years, it is rumored to emerge as if from the very air. It can never be found by the same soul twice. It is truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Catalina (re-nameable) has always been enthralled by the mystique of this transitory carnival filled with dark beauty. One night, she finds herself there, as if by magick. Eager to experience it all, she catches the attention of four alluring performers.

Her enchanted night turns into a nightmare when she discovers the carnival has a dark side. Carnival goers go insane, attack each other, and mutate into alien-like horrors.

Can Catalina survive or escape the Carnival or Curiosities before it consumes her?

[From [url=https://terraessencedreams.itch.io/twisted-carnival]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
没有人知道好奇心嘉年华会出现在哪里。据传，每隔五年，它就会像凭空出现一样。同一个灵魂永远不可能两次找到它。这确实是一次千载难逢的经历。

卡塔琳娜（已重名）一直被这个充满黑暗之美的转瞬即逝的狂欢节的神秘感所吸引。一天晚上，她发现自己就在那里，就像施了魔法一样。渴望体验这一切的她引起了四位迷人表演者的注意。

当她发现嘉年华也有阴暗面时，她的迷人之夜变成了一场噩梦。狂欢节的观众会发疯，互相攻击，甚至变异成外星人般的恐怖生物。

卡塔琳娜能否在嘉年华或好奇心吞噬她之前生存或逃脱？

[来自[url=https://terraessencedreams.itch.io/twisted-carnival]itch.io[/url]]
